verdict.rationale: The evidence shows online filing (the Annual Report Wizard and online LLC formation) and an 'Authorized Users' UCC e-filing system. None of it documents how users sign in: no credential-based MFA, and nothing ruling out biometric liveness, in-person visits, or mailed PINs. The probe confirms only that the public Business Center page is reachable without credentials, which says nothing about the authenticated sign-in path.
